Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: RFQ SH-220 – offer:DEMO-C1-0
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for offer:DEMO-C1-0 at 16.00 EUR per unit; we note the standard lead time of 45 days, which does not fit our production schedule.

Could you confirm your earliest feasible lead time and quote DAP with 60-day payment? A short cost breakdown for SH-220 would help us evaluate.

Our counter-proposals for 6000 pcs/year over 24 months:
1. 15.50 EUR, DAP, net 60 days, lead 35 days.
2. 15.90 EUR, DAP, net 45 days, lead 42 days.
3. 16.00 EUR, FCA, net 30 days, lead 42 days.

We are comparing several capable suppliers and value a reliable long-term partnership.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
